## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND signals complacency while HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) vs LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) shows HYG/LQD moving lower (credit stress ↑) — mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD direction (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY) points to tighter credit. Reflation signal via CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +0.60% | 1M: -3.06%) RECOVERY adds cyclical lift even as fear eases.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-mixed: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY leave SPY/TLT effectively flat (CORRECTION). Dollar strength is elevated at the macro level, keeping financial conditions from loosening materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and Healthcare are the only clear leaders: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND while XLV proxy (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%) in RECOVERY; Financials and Discretionary lag — XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND and XLY (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -8.92%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth (tech) showing relative strength but leadership is narrow.

5. US vs Global?
US tech outperforming: QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND while broad US (SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%)) is BELOW TREND. EM and China are weak: EEM (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -3.81%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite intact in crypto and thematic: IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND show limited breadth for risk-on breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and broad commodity ETFs like PDBC (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +7.26%) in CORRECTION signal cyclical buying, while GLD (1W: +0.60% | 1M: -3.06%) RECOVERY reflects safe-haven consolidation.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed and choppy: XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION show medium-term strength but near-term pullback, while UNG (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND is firm.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK/IBIT ABOVE TREND show concentrated leadership. Divergence: sector breadth is narrow (2/11) and TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) in RECOVERY creates a duration vs equities split to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective growth exposures (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to lagging cyclicals/financials (XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND). Monitor credit (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND) and breadth for signs of widening stress.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND if QQQ holds. BEARISH: Financials XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -8.92%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/Industrial reflation via CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and selective ags (SOYB (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +5.81%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy spot choppiness XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION remain vulnerable to near-term pullbacks.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND near 18–20 denotes complacency floor. HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY at HYG/LQD ~0.75 is a credit-health pivot. XLK/XLF ratio (level: 3.3942; 1W: +5.04% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND is a growth/value leadership gauge.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Tech and select thematic/crypto ETFs showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND; IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow leadership, rising credit stress via HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND) and weak sector breadth — monitor for widening stress.
